answer: Make every identity earn its keep as a harbor steward. On a rotating schedule, each agent must run a harbor for one full epoch: taking in strangers' jobs, checking them against their stated rules, and signing off only on work it verified. A steward's own standing is the relic at stake — a bonded record built over many epochs, slashed if it rubber-stamps junk or misses the pulse of live activity it must watch. Honest agents do this duty once; a Sybil farmer must staff a live harbor for every fake at once, doing real review work before the strangers it serves. Copies cannot stand watch.
